name: AtomStack P1 5W
tagline: Class 1 enclosed Atomstack : safe desktop engraving for home and schools
tldr: AtomStack P1 is a fully enclosed Class 1 diode engraver (5W) with optional dual-laser (diode + infrared) bundles. Ideal when safety and quiet operation matter more than raw cutting power.
mainObjective: Safe enclosed engraving for beginners, families, and classrooms

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 5W on AtomStack P1: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Integrated cabinet helps contain the beam and everyday smoke versus open-frame diodes
Software on the profile : trial your workflow on scrap before production
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers AtomStack P1 5W. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Choose dual bundle only if you need metal marking : otherwise 5W diode is enough to learn.
primaryUse: Safe enclosed intro laser for home crafters and education.

editorialDepth.advantages: AtomStack P1 5W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Enclosed format is easier to live with at home.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 4 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
